queries: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, site_count, site_count * 1.0 / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts
